messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: multiple region health checks flapping between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu. Spike in 502/504s and request latency starting 1715432058. Auto-fallback routing engaged.
morgan: I'm on it. seeing repeated health toggles on the control plane: us-east reports eu as unhealthy, eu reports us-west unhealthy, us-west reports us-east unhealthy. looks like a 3-node flipchain.
deepa: confirm customer impact? any customer-facing errors in metrics? sam-product: noticed a surge of user-reported slowdowns in EU dashboards, some webhooks failing with 502s. severity looks P1 for affected customers.
jc: pulling routing logs now. pattern: health probe TTL 3s, probe timeouts ~150ms, and we have automated fallback that immediately shifts traffic across regions. it's a classic pogo/pogo-stick loop.
oncall-sre: paging rotation: morgan (oncall), deepa (sre), jc (runtime). alex (platform) please standby.
alex: I can patch routing policy to add debounce, or temporary disable cross-region fallback. which is preferred for minimal customer impact?
morgan: priority is stop the flip loop. temp action: disable cross-region automatic fallback for the smart-routing policy for the affected model family. fallback to same-region cached variants only.
deepa: agree. also increase healthcheck flapping threshold to avoid immediate failover. current config:

```
smart_routing:
  fallback_policy: cross-region
  health_check:
    interval_ms: 2000
    failure_threshold: 1
    recovery_threshold: 1
```

Let's change to:

```
smart_routing:
  fallback_policy: local-only
  health_check:
    interval_ms: 3000
    failure_threshold: 3
    recovery_threshold: 2
```

jc: applying now. I'll run the change as a quick config patch.
devops-bot: Received config patch request from jc. Running canary validation...
devops-bot: Canary passed (5/5 checks). Rolling config to control plane for tri-region policy.
jc: patched control plane policy to local-only and raised thresholds. Publishing rollout id 2024-1715432132.
alex: temporarily scaling up eu pool by +2 gpu nodes to absorb traffic while routes settle.
oncall-sre: annotation: manual override by jc at 1715432135. monitoring for stabilization.
morgan: telemetry: health-check flaps subsided within 45s of the change. error rate down from 7% -> 1.2%. latency p95 in eu still elevated by ~120ms vs baseline.
sam-product: notifying affected customers: sending interim status update that we mitigated cross-region churn and are monitoring. ETA for full recovery TBD.
deepa: post-mitigation: need root cause analysis. suspicious that probe timeouts were correlated with a mis-sized KV-cache eviction on fallback variant leading to slower probe replies when a variant got traffic spike.
jc: logs show a single model variant in us-west responded with slow KV eviction GC around 1715432008 causing 200ms probe slowness. that triggered fallback, which caused eu to get traffic, stressed eu, and the chain continued.
alex: follow-up actions (short):
- revert smart-routing fallback to previous after stabilization with controlled rollout and increased debounce.
- schedule patch to health-checking to check probe latency percentiles before marking unhealthy.
- add variant-weighting guard so wrong/older model variants aren't chosen as fallback.
- add automated circuit-breaker on cross-region failovers if >2 switches/minute.

morgan: ok. I'll file a postmortem and assign owners: jc (control-plane fix), alex (capacity & variant-weight guard), deepa (healthcheck guard), sam-product (customer comms).
jc: creating incident item: INC-1715432100. linking runbook steps and the config diff.
devops-bot: Incident INC-1715432100 created. runbook template attached.
sam-product: sent customer update at 1715432400. will follow up with more details after RCA.
alex: leaving a temporary note in console: "Cross-region fallback disabled for tri-region policy until RCA complete." will schedule revert during low-traffic window tomorrow.
morgan: final status: immediate flip loop mitigated by local-only fallback + increased health debounce. Customer impact: partial degradation (latency + some 502s) for ~6 minutes peak window. continuing RCA and actions listed above. :white_check_mark:
